    "None of these items gave me a clear reason to buy now. My recent purchases were fastening and hanging supplies, and wiring connectors or tubing require a different task that I have not shown a need for.",

    "The suggestions treat workshop supplies as interchangeable, although hanging, fastening, wiring and grinding solve different problems.",
    "The electronics wording in my screw assortment seems to have been taken as interest in electrical work, even though screws alone do not show that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I bought two kinds of magnetic hooks close together, which is a clearer sign of interest in magnetic hanging than in general workshop consumables.",
    "My recent washers, screws and hooks point toward fastening and hanging tasks; a useful next choice would need a clear connection to those functions.",
    "I rarely interact, so an item needs to address a concrete current need rather than a hypothetical future project."
  ],
